repos_data.description: The Open Context Layer for Data and AI ,  OpenMetadata is the open platform for building trusted data context and business semantics for humans, AI assistants, and agents.
The open-source context layer for your AI. Catalog your tables, topics, queues and APIs then expose real metadata to your AI agents.

Open-source data quality tool: profiles tables, generates data quality tests from the profiling results, and runs them on a schedule with freshness, volume, and schema monitoring. Web UI, REST API, and MCP server. 14 databases plus CSV, Parquet, and JSON files. Apache 2.0.
A detective for your data. Zero-config data quality monitoring — works with dbt, Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake. No YAML.
